address.line2: Aqua Beach (Hat Aqua) / Ao Nam Mao Beach area
address.subdistrict: Sai Thai (per Google) / Ao Nang (per Facebook)
address.full: 10 Moo 5, Sai Thai, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000, Thailand
address.verification_note: Sources disagree on subdistrict — verify with owner. Both 'Sai Thai' (Google) and 'Ao Nang' (Facebook) appear in listings. The restaurant is located on the stretch of beach between Ao Nang and Ao Nam Mao, accessible from both.

hours.note: 11.00น-21.30น per Google. Verify with owner — beachfront restaurants sometimes close earlier in monsoon (May-Oct).

map_embed_query: Ra Beung Lay Seafood Restaurant Aqua Beach Krabi
best_for: Sunset dinner (the view is the sell)
Tourists wanting an 'authentic' Thai seafood experience without going off-grid

atmosphere.setting: Open-air, beachfront, partly under bamboo and thatched roof structures
seating_styles: Long communal wooden tables under thatched roof
Low Thai-style mats on raised wood platforms
Tables right on the sand with sea view
atmosphere.view: Direct ocean view with Krabi karst formations in the distance
atmosphere.best_seat: Tables nearest the waterline at sunset

travel_info.from_railay_beach: Boat to Ao Nam Mao pier + 5 min walk
travel_info.parking: On-site parking available — verify capacity with owner
travel_info.accessibility_note: Sand-floor seating; not all tables wheelchair-accessible. The thatched-roof platform tables are the most accessible option.
